item.title: Comment on The second attempted coup d’etat was partially successful by Craig
item.description:
Long time reader. This post is unbecoming of this blog. There are valid concerns to be had about how in the loop President Biden has been in certain decisions of his administration. They are worthy of the sober discussion of well meaning people and warrant a degree of soul searching amongst those of us who opposed Trump and supported him and VP Harris. To call it a coup is to fall into the same, weird, manic, extremist, sleep deprived miasma that tens of millions of our terminally online countrymen find themselves stuck in.
